test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: L, M, N, O, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Q sits to the immediate right of N. Only three people sit between Q and S when counted from the left of Q. Only three people sit between N and M. L sits to the immediate right of R. How many people sit between O and R when counted from the left of R?
